steps.en: Install the desktop app, then sign in or choose Skip Sign-In for local agents
steps.zh: 装好桌面端，登录或选“跳过登录”只用本地 agent

steps.en: Connect a subscription, API key or local model and pick a harness
steps.zh: 接入订阅、API key 或本地模型，选一个 harness

steps.en: Runs that agent in your project folder, with tool calls and approval cards
steps.zh: 在项目目录里跑该 agent，展示工具调用和审批卡片

steps.en: Open the same session from your phone or another signed-in computer
steps.zh: 从手机或另一台已登录电脑打开同一会话

steps.en: Relays allowlisted session actions to the desktop and streams results back
steps.zh: 把白名单内的会话操作转给桌面端，并回传结果

value.en: One agent session follows you across desktops and a phone without renting a server
value.zh: 一个 agent 会话跟着你在电脑和手机间接续，不用租服务器
